# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 83 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 83

Jesus said: "People can see the images, but the light inside them is hidden within the image of the Father's light. That light will appear — and the image will be veiled by it."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "People can see" — more direct than "are manifest to"
- "The light inside them" — the interior quality of the light
- "That light will appear" — clearer antecedent for "he" (the Father's light)
- "Veiled by it" — the concealment through excessive brightness
